summary: Welltower Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement registering up to 176,172 shares of common stock to be issued in exchange for Class A common units of Welltower OP LLC tendered for redemption. The registration satisfies a contractual obligation; no cash proceeds are received by Welltower. The shares trade on NYSE under WELL, with a last reported price of $214.23 per share on April 28, 2026. This is a routine registration for possible unit redemptions, not a standalone special situation. The filing does not reflect a corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer—it is a shelf takedown to facilitate existing redemption rights.
